Game Overview

At its heart, Dino Offline Game is a arcade game about escape into the pixelated desert as a nimble T-Rex, racing against cacti and pterodactyls in this addictive, fast-paced runner. Keep your reflexes sharp as you strive to outlast the barren landscape in an infinite game of survival and speed.

Playing Dino Offline Game comes down to a simple loop. Escape into the pixelated desert as a nimble T-Rex, racing against cacti and pterodactyls in this addictive, fast-paced runner. Keep your reflexes sharp as you strive to outlast the barren landscape in an infinite game of survival and speed.
